text:
Gabe Turner: heads-up: card decline for Nimbus Labs (acct ending 1123). automated charge failed for autopay. invoices NL-7710 and NL-7711.
Mina Shah: decline code? was it an AVS mismatch or bank decline?
billing-bot: alert: payment_method=card_last4=1123 status=declined code=do_not_honor attempts=1
CS-Rachel: reached out to their AP. they said card hit daily limit; offered to wire today or set up ACH. asked for wire template and remittance instructions.
Gabe Turner: run one scheduled retry immediately then pause retries. hold dunning for 48h while CS coordinates. tag account=no_auto_retry.
billing-bot: action logged: auto_retry=attempted timestamp=1775129930 result=failed ticket=AR-9002
AR-Luke: please mark invoices pending_payment and set expected action=customer_wire_or_ach. also capture outstanding balance: $22,180. threshold for hold = $50k so no service hold.
CS-Rachel: sent customer minimal wire template (no acct nums in Slack):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [please confirm]
Reference: Nimbus Labs + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX
```
CS-Rachel: also offered ACH link: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup and asked them to upload remittance email or payment screenshot once submitted.
Mina Shah: add note for reconciliation: ask client to include invoice numbers and amounts in remittance. once funds land, reconcile to invoice order (oldest first).
Gabe Turner: if they wire, we will need the bank's intermediary info for international wires. tell CS to request SWIFT+intermediary if outside US.
CS-Rachel: Nimbus replied: "we'll wire EOD, expect 1-2 business days. attaching payment_note.pdf."
AR-Luke: uploaded payment_note.pdf to AR-9002 and set status=pending_wire. scheduled manual follow-up in 48h.
billing-bot: reminder scheduled: check_ticket=AR-9002 remind_at=1775216301
Mina Shah: documented internal plan: Day0 retry attempted; Day1 pause + CS outreach; Day2 reconcile if funds landed; Day4 escalate to AR lead if not.
Gabe Turner: one more: if wire fails or gets returned, automatically offer ACH and then check for partial card payment. also log decline_reason in CRM to reduce retries.
CS-Rachel: client asked whether partial payment is acceptable. i said we'll accept partial if it's confirmed and will apply to oldest invoice; otherwise wait for full remittance.
AR-Luke: added tags: pending_wire, nimbus, high_touch. leaving ticket open.
Gabe Turner: closing loop here. next check-in 1775133501 (~10h). thanks all :thumbsup:
CS-Rachel: noted. will update when remittance arrives.
AR-Luke: end of thread.
